features.name: Gradio Web UI
features.description: Main user interface for generation, auditing, and configuration.

features.name: Benchmark Runner
features.description: Executes batch generation for benchmarks.

features.name: Generalized Story Schema
features.description: Dataclasses for StorySpec, CharacterSpec, SceneSpec.

features.name: LLM Story Analyzer (Gemini)
features.description: Parses narrative into StorySpec using Gemini API.

features.name: Heuristic NLP Parser
features.description: Rule-based parser if LLM fails or API key is missing.

features.name: Character Registry
features.description: Stores canonical character images (base64) and biometric embeddings.

features.name: Scene Planner
features.description: Computes denoising schedule, resolves controlnet references.

features.name: Prompt Builder
features.description: Injects demographic traits and handles regional BREAK tokens.

features.name: ControlNet Conditioner
features.description: Manages payload creation for OpenPose and Depth models.

features.name: LoRA Registry
features.description: Scans local disk for LoRAs and injects them into prompts.

features.name: Refinement Controller
features.description: Builds payload for ReActor + CodeFormer face restoration.

features.name: Regional Conditioner
features.description: Handles column ratio metadata for regional prompting.

features.name: Cross-Frame Conditioner
features.description: Implemented tracking but logic is mostly unused in current orchestrator flow.

features.name: IP-Adapter SDXL
features.description: Primary SOTA identity adapter using CLIP-ViT-bigG.

features.name: InstantID SDXL
features.description: Implementation exists, but suffers from Forge preprocessor dict unpack errors at runtime.

features.name: FaceID Plus v2
features.description: Native FaceID Plus v2 SDXL adapter.

features.name: Forge API Client
features.description: Low-level API wrapper for interacting with SD Forge.

features.name: Generation Orchestrator
features.description: Executes the 2-pass deterministic generation pipeline.

features.name: VRAM Telemetry Guard
features.description: Monitors VRAM usage and cleans up memory between generations.

features.name: Programmatic Auditor
features.description: Evaluates spatial (face count), biometric (ArcFace), and prop (CLIP zero-shot) constraints.

features.name: Healing Controller
features.description: Diagnoses QA failures and triggers re-generation with adjusted parameters (e.g., enable OpenPose, increase CFG).

features.name: Metrics Engine
features.description: Provides Core mathematical and CV operations (ArcFace, SSIM, CLIP wrapper).
